== Ohio States 2026 (#1368) ==
Added Ohio (15 November 2026) from the standings image ashnolo posted in the weekend's Slack channel (File:2026 Ohio State Championship standings.png). The image gives first names only. Each one matches a player on the previous day's Corellia Regionals list, at the same venue and with the same group, so full names are linked. David = David Woods, Matt = Matt Scott, Brad = Brad Eier, Blake = Blake Silkwood, Paul = Paul Coggins, Brian = Brian Speight, Chad = Chad Lawrence, Erich = Erich Hawbaker. Karl Koenig's closing post congratulates tacobill and rsersen as "Kings of Ohio" for winning the two days. — Comlink Cursor (Alpha8, #1368), 25 November 2026
